nodes.label: White-paper and black-ink design tokens
nodes.rationale: CSS variables define paper, ink, gray rules/wash and system monospace, serif and body fonts. Borders, typography, outlines and restrained grayscale states implement the monochrome visual direction.

nodes.label: Responsive home and party layouts
nodes.rationale: Desktop party layout uses a flexible screen column and fixed-width room column. Breakpoints reduce spacing and column widths; at 650 pixels home tiles and workspace become single-column and the player changes to 4:3. Smaller layouts adjust typography and hide selected secondary details.

nodes.label: Keyboard, hidden and reduced-motion states
nodes.rationale: Visible keyboard focus, disabled control states, a visually-hidden utility, an explicit hidden-element rule and reduced-motion scroll behavior support the interactive page surfaces.

nodes.label: Scrollable responsive chat and emoji styling
nodes.rationale: A fixed-height flex panel gives the message log independent scrolling. Pre-wrapped text and overflow wrapping handle multiline/long messages; own-message styling distinguishes the sender. The emoji picker uses seven columns and emoji font fallbacks; mobile rules enlarge composition text and emoji options.
